A(E)\le C(n)D(E)^{1/2},
\]
where $B$ is the unit ball, $r_E=(|E|/\omega_n)^{1/n}$,
\[
A(E):=\inf_{x\in\mathbb{R}^n}\frac{|E\mathbin{\triangle}(x+r_EB)|}{|E|},
\qquad
D(E):=\frac{P(E)}{n\omega_n^{1/n}|E|^{(n-1)/n}}-1.
\]
